mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and unemployment (UNRATE) indicates stagflationary pressures that trigger central bank tightening and reduced corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between CPIAUCSL and UNRATE fails to produce negative returns in more than 55% of cases when both series exceed their 90th percentile thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and credit availability, which drive equity valuations higher, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with rising HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and economic momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO's 5-day forward returns show a negative Rank IC below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) combined with a persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, causing market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% and FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates and reducing credit availability, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles with rising FEDFUNDS.
